description: Check whether a US pest control company holds a state license record. Searches PestPin's directory of official state regulator records (35 states, reprocessed from official sources on a recurring schedule; publication timing varies by regulator). Returns matched businesses with license number, state, status at PestPin's last check, the date that check happened, and the official state source link so the answer can be verified at the regulator. Use it when someone names a company and wants to know if it is licensed. A miss is not proof a company is unlicensed: coverage is 35 states, some businesses are excluded as lawn, agricultural or government records, and name spellings vary.

company.description: Business name (or license number) to search for, e.g. Acme Pest Control

state.description: Optional two-letter US state code to narrow the search, e.g. FL

name: verify_license

matches.description: Matched license records, empty when nothing matched

inDirectorySince.description: ISO date the record first cleared PestPin's checks

lastCheckedAt.description: Same as sourceCheckedOn when the record carries its own check date

licenseNumber.description: License number on the state record

licenseState.description: Two-letter state that issued the license

name.description: Business name as the state record spells it

officialSourceAgency.description: Name of the state agency that publishes the record

sourceCheckedOn.description: ISO date PestPin last processed the source behind this record

sourceCheckedOnScope.description: 'record' when the date is this record's own last check, 'state' when it is the last time PestPin processed that state's source

status.description: What the record said at PestPin's last check

verifyAtOfficialSource.description: Official state regulator page where this record can be checked

note.description: The limits a reader must be told

totalMatches.description: How many records matched in total

title: Check a pest control license
